measurements.evidence_quote: Ζ-potential (surface charge) measurements on microplastic samples were performed using Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) analyses, with a Zetasizer Instrument, Nano ZS90 Series (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, UK), working with He–Ne laser (emission λ = 633 nm). || Measurements were performed at a fixed temperature (T = 25 °C) using a Peltier thermostatic system, with an equilibrating time set to 120 s. || MPs were dispersed in deionised water to reach a final concentration of 0.1 mg mL-1. || Measurements were performed in triplicate, and each measurement consisted of 20 runs. || Fig. 3. Z-potential measurement in investigated samples
